intent.title: Import an HTML file: tags, text, inline marks and attributes
steps: Choose File > Import HTML and pick an .html file with headings, paragraphs with strong/em/a, lists, a table, a form, images and links.
expected: Each supported tag becomes the matching element type in the document JSON with its text, inline marks and supported attributes (href, src, alt, type, name, ...).
Element names are taken from BEM classes when present, else from the element type.
The import is one undo step.

intent.title: Import cleaning: scripts, unknown elements, broken nesting and the import report
steps: Import an HTML file that contains an inline
expected: Scripts are not dropped: each is kept with its page (its code or its src), never run on the editing canvas, written back by the export, and listed in the report; event handler attributes are removed and listed in the report.
Unknown elements are unwrapped into their children.
Structures that break the nesting rules are repaired (e.g. a stray li gets a ul) or dropped; the resulting document always passes the nesting rules.
An import report lists everything that was dropped, unwrapped, repaired or kept, with the source line.

intent.title: Import CSS: style attributes, style blocks and linked stylesheets
steps: Choose File > Import HTML and pick, in one selection, an HTML file and the stylesheet it links; the page also has a <style> block with class, tag and id rules and style attributes (a fixture whose rules are all mappable).
Import the same page again without its stylesheet.
expected: The import accepts several files at once; a linked stylesheet is found by its path among the picked files.
Declarations that apply to each element, resolved by specificity and order, become that element styles in the document JSON.
For this fixture, the computed styles of every element in the iframe match the original file opened in Chrome.
A linked stylesheet that was not picked is listed in the import report.

intent.title: Import @media rules as breakpoint overrides
steps: Import an HTML file whose CSS has @media (max-width: 834px) and @media (max-width: 390px) rules, and a @media (min-width: 1000px) rule.
expected: max-width rules at a breakpoint width become overrides of that breakpoint; other widths map to the nearest breakpoint at or below them and are reported.
Rules that cannot be mapped (min-width, orientation, print) are listed in the import report.
At each breakpoint the computed styles in the iframe match the original page at that width for every element not affected by a reported rule.

intent.title: Import pseudo-class rules as state styles
steps: Import an HTML file whose CSS has :hover, :focus, :active, :disabled, :invalid and :placeholder-shown rules, plus a descendant selector and an @supports block.
expected: Each supported pseudo-class rule becomes a state style of the matching element in the document JSON.
Selectors that cannot be mapped to single elements (descendant rules across unrelated elements, @supports, ::before) are listed in the import report.
In preview, hovering an imported element shows its hover styles.

intent.title: Exported pages import back unchanged
steps: Build a page using templates, breakpoint overrides and hover states and export it.
Choose File > Import HTML and pick the exported ZIP.
expected: Importing a ZIP imports its pages together with their linked CSS files as a whole.

The imported document equals the original in tag structure, texts, attributes and styles per breakpoint and state; element types are compared by HTML tag (types that share a tag, such as Link and Link Block, cannot be told apart in plain HTML); ids and editor-only data (locks, layer colours, guides, grid settings, saved colours) are ignored.
Element names are recovered from their BEM classes, so the second export is byte-identical to the first.

intent.title: Paste HTML and text copied from outside the app
steps: Put text/html of a small article (heading, paragraphs, a list, a script tag) on the system clipboard and press Ctrl+V with a Section selected.
Put multi-line text/plain on the system clipboard and press Ctrl+V with a Section selected.
expected: Pasted HTML goes through the HTML importer (same cleaning and nesting rules) and is inserted into the selection as one undo step; scripts in pasted HTML are not kept, because a pasted fragment has no page to keep them with.
Plain text becomes one Paragraph per line.
Anything the importer drops is reported in the status bar.
